exposure: Cervical 3D volumes (total cervical volume, stroma volume)
outcome: Quality of reconstructed images and segmentations
cohort: 97 nulliparous women in late gestation (36-41 weeks) attempting their first vaginal birth, recruited to the MiBirth study.
finding: An increased late gestation cervical volume was associated with an increased risk of caesarean section, even when controlling for maternal age.
mod_finding: An increased cervical volume was associated with an increased risk of caesarean section (OR 1.09, p = 0.04).
